# Labs

A lab is a hands-on learning guide generated from a chat. It takes the conversation context and produces a structured set of steps with an interactive checklist for tracking your progress.

## Generating a lab

From any chat, look for the "Generate lab" action. Clicking it sends the chat's assembled context to the AI, which produces a structured output containing:

- **Title** — a short name for the lab.
- **Introduction** — context and goals.
- **Steps** — numbered instructions, each rendered as markdown.
- **Checklist** — a list of tasks to complete, each with a checkbox.

The lab is persisted as a leaf artifact on the chat. It does not branch — a lab belongs to exactly one chat.

## The lab runner

The lab view renders the generated content as a scrollable guide:

1. The title and introduction appear at the top.
2. Each step is displayed in order with full markdown rendering (headings, code blocks, lists, images if referenced).
3. Below the steps, the interactive checklist shows each task with a checkbox.

## Interactive checklist

Click any checklist item to toggle its completion state. The progress is saved immediately — close the lab and reopen it later, and your completed items persist.

A counter next to the "Checklist" heading shows your progress in the form "2/5 done" — two of the five items completed. Checked items are crossed off in the list so you can see at a glance what is left.

## Progress tracking

The checklist is stored as JSON in the database (`labs.checklist`). Each item has:

- **id** — unique identifier.
- **text** — the task description.
- **done** — boolean completion state.

Labs and their checklists live in Mayon's PostgreSQL database — the same server-side database that holds every other part of the app (see [Data and Privacy](data-and-privacy.qmd)). The Mayon server must be running for labs to work. In return, your progress is durable: it survives page reloads, app restarts, and container restarts, because the database persists in the `pg-data` Docker volume.

## Customizing generation

The instructions Mayon follows when generating a lab can be adjusted in **Settings → Lab generation prompt**. The settings page shows the built-in lab instructions (read-only) alongside a text box for your own additions. Anything you write there is appended after the built-in instructions when a lab is generated — the built-in rules always come first and cannot be changed, so your notes refine the output (shorter steps, a different tone, a focus on particular skills) without altering what a lab is. Clearing the text box, or using the "Reset instructions" button, returns generation to the default behavior.

## Generating another lab

Generating a lab never replaces anything. Each click of "Generate lab" creates a brand-new lab from the chat's current context, and labs you generated earlier are kept exactly as they are. All labs from a chat are listed in that chat's sidebar, so an earlier version — including its checklist progress — stays one click away. A newly generated lab starts with every checklist item unchecked; it does not inherit progress from any earlier lab.

## Link back to the chat

The lab view includes a link back to its parent chat. This lets you return to the conversation that generated the lab, ask follow-up questions, and generate an updated version.
